extracted.name: Caramel Apples
extracted.description: Caramel apples are a Halloween delight: Crunchy red apples on sticks, bathed in gooey caramel. Decorate with chopped nuts, melted chocolate, or candy.
ingredient_lines: 1 (14 ounce) package individually wrapped caramels, unwrapped
instruction_lines: Remove the stem from each apple and press a craft stick into the top. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray.
Place caramels and milk in a microwave-safe bowl; microwave for 2 minutes, stirring once. Set aside to cool briefly.
Roll each apple quickly in caramel sauce until well coated. Place on prepared sheet to set.
Enjoy! Celebrate fall in the sweetest way: With this homemade caramel apple recipe!
